5-category objection playbook — 25 word-for-word responses rehearsed 25-45s each. TRUST (5): who's behind / MOD-before / accreditation / references / go-bust. BUDGET (5): £180k floor / no-budget / build-vs-buy / competitor cheaper / milestones. URGENCY (5): 6-mo window / next FY / pilot at risk / faster competitors / call-back. PRIME (5): existing prime / prime refuses / white-label / pre-empts / prove it. TECHNICAL (5): LangChain / Palantir / IP-theft / hyperscaler / upgrade path + 5 general rules + 5 never-to-dos + 3-signal close moves.
